subject: Request: PoC extension + sandbox credit (SAML integration)
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@clearportlabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: PoC hold: request for extension + credits

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the help so far. We hit an unexpected blocker with our SAML integration during the staging rollout this morning — our IdP is returning an unexpected assertion attribute that breaks the connector handshake. Our engineers are digging in, but it's going to set us back at least two weeks on the demo timeline.

Because the PoC window is tight and our team needs time to validate the identity flow end-to-end, could we request a 30-day extension to the sandbox period and a one-time sandbox credit top-up (we estimate ~150k token-worth of additional usage to finish validation and run the end-to-end scenarios)?

I attached the SAML error log and the latest PoC SOW for reference. We really want to keep momentum with the execs — the demo is currently scheduled for 4/12 and slipping it would be painful for our pilot sign-off.

Appreciate any flexibility you can provide. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

—Olivia Chen
Director of Engineering, ClearPort Labs
olivia@clearportlabs.com

Attachments: saml_error_log.txt, PoC_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@clearportlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC hold: request for extension + credits

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs.

I'm sorry to hear you've run into the SAML assertion mismatch. We can absolutely help with both the extension and a temporary credit top-up while your engineers work through the IdP behavior. Before I do the formal approval/ops work I have two quick asks:

- Can your team share the exact assertion payload (or a redacted dump) and the IdP config you're using? That will let our infra team reproduce quickly.
- Can you confirm the minimum token uplift you need to complete end-to-end validation? You mentioned ~150k — is 150k a firm lower bound or an estimate?

Plan I'm proposing: I can provision an interim 50k token sandbox bump immediately (to buy you a few days) and open an internal approval for a larger one-time top-up/extension. I'll loop Laura for approval routing and Marissa for any exception sign-off if needed.

Would you be available for a short triage call today at 2pm PT? If so, I'll send a calendar invite and loop in an engineer.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Strategic POCs
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Office: (415) 555-0134
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.co le@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PoC hold: request for extension + credits

Marcus / Marissa — forwarding ClearPort's request. Summary of situation:

- PoC stalled by SAML IdP assertion mismatch discovered in staging. Customer provided error log (attached).
- They requested a 30-day sandbox extension + ~150k tokens to complete validations and run full demo scenarios.
- Risk: executive demo scheduled 4/12; if date slips, momentum + likelihood of pilot signature decreases.

Recommendation: approve a 75k token top-up now (gives them runway for triage + a second batch of tests) and grant a 30-day extension to the PoC window. Require a brief milestone (IdP assertion parity validated) as condition for the larger one-time credit beyond 75k. We can also offer a one-hour engineering deep-dive within the next 48 hours to accelerate the fix.

Related deal: DL-2027-0899 — ACV potential looks healthy; I'd consider this a high-priority retention/expansion assist.

If you approve, I'll file the credit and update the HubSpot record, and Marcus will coordinate the scheduled eng support.

—Laura
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co le@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@clearportlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC hold: request for extension + credits

Marcus / Laura / Olivia — thanks for the context and for the quick coordination.

Approved: Redwood will provide a one-time 75,000 token sandbox top-up and extend ClearPort Labs' PoC window by 30 days from the current expiry date. This approval is conditional on:

1) ClearPort confirms the IdP assertion parity milestone (brief note in the thread) within two weeks, and
2) We schedule the one-hour engineering deep-dive this week (Marcus, please coordinate and invite the relevant infra engineer).

Marcus — please:
- Apply the 75k token credit to the ClearPort sandbox (work with Ops to attach to deal DL-2027-0899),
- Update the HubSpot deal with the extension and credit details (link below), and
- Send the eng deep-dive calendar invite to Olivia / Sam and our infra engineer (CC Laura).

Olivia — sorry for the interruption to your timeline. We're committed to helping you get back on track for the 4/12 demo. Let us know if you need anything else from my side.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
